g.text: sMove R2 MAIN | one-sheet wiring | ENGINEERING PROTOTYPE

g.desc: sMove R2 MAIN | one-sheet wiring | ENGINEERING PROTOTYPE

g.text: USB100 fixed (90mA guaranteed-min input). Protected 4.2V pack only. No automatic cell-temperature sensing.

g.desc: USB100 fixed (90mA guaranteed-min input). Protected 4.2V pack only. No automatic cell-temperature sensing.

g.text: Native USB: disconnect before host sleep/off. ROM/crash does not enforce data isolation.

g.desc: Native USB: disconnect before host sleep/off. ROM/crash does not enforce data isolation.

g.text: Charge ONLY supervised, off-body, qualified protected pack and independent bench temperature monitoring. Cell acceptance >=121mA and 4.23V.

g.desc: Charge ONLY supervised, off-body, qualified protected pack and independent bench temperature monitoring. Cell acceptance >=121mA and 4.23V.

g.text: NO cell sensing: TS 10k bias permitted by TI. Default timers: TMR open. ITERM open. CE/EN1/EN2 grounded.

g.desc: NO cell sensing: TS 10k bias permitted by TI. Default timers: TMR open. ITERM open. CE/EN1/EN2 grounded.

g.text: PGOOD_N low = valid USB. Firmware detach on loss. ADC is an LDO headroom screen, NOT a fuel gauge.

g.desc: PGOOD_N low = valid USB. Firmware detach on loss. ADC is an LDO headroom screen, NOT a fuel gauge.
